desc: stock gives the starting quantity of each sku; skus in stock are distinct and quantities are at least 0. Apply the transactions in order, adding delta to the sku's quantity. If a transaction's sku is not in stock (whatever its delta), return the error "txn N: unknown sku S"; if it would make the quantity negative, return the error "txn N: S would go negative", where N is the 1-based position of the transaction and S its sku. Transactions never add new skus. Otherwise return the final Stock entries for the skus whose final quantity is greater than 0, ordered by sku in ascending code-point order.
